pure-announcement.rationale: This is an educational anti-patterns listicle synthesizing agent-building guidance, with no product, release, or funding being announced.

duplicate.rationale: No existing concept is an agent anti-pattern catalog; individual items brush against siem-agentic-visibility-gap (observability) and the evals concepts, but a reader of those learns none of the other anti-patterns here.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Each claim is a checkable design principle backed by cited vendor engineering guides (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, MongoDB) that a reader can verify.

durability.rationale: The content is timeless architectural and operational principles — start with one agent, keep tools minimal and non-overlapping, design layered memory early, separate read/write permissions, treat context as finite, evaluate before deploy — with no version numbers or adoption lists to date it.

actionability.rationale: Every anti-pattern comes with a concrete fix a builder can apply (namespace overlapping tools, cap tool-output size, session/long-term/log memory tiers, human confirmation for irreversible writes, adversarial eval tied to business metrics).

atomicity.rationale: The note is an explicit catalog of nine separable anti-patterns (premature multi-agent, overloaded agent, tool sprawl, hardcoded logic, missing memory, no observability, ungoverned write access, context drift, skipped evaluation), each a standalone concept, so the split is the finding.
